name: Cash used to pay suppliers and wages directly
description: Owner pays suppliers, rent or staff in cash taken from takings before banking.
fp: May have innocent explanations; assess in context of customer profile and other indicators.

sources.text: OECD, Electronic Sales Suppression: A Threat to Tax Revenues (2013)
OECD, Shining Light on the Shadow Economy: Opportunities and Threats (2017)
FATF/OECD, Money Laundering Awareness Handbook for Tax Examiners and Tax Auditors (2012)
FATF and OECD, Money Laundering Awareness Handbook for Tax Examiners and Tax Auditors (2012)
